abbreviations.definition: cluster (2 dc worked together in the same space: [yo, insert hook, yo and pull up a loop, yo and pull through 2 loops] twice, then yo and pull through all 3 loops)

rows.instructions: Magic ring. With Colour 1, 8 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. (8 sc)
Ch 3 (counts as dc), 1 dc in first sc, 2 dc in each remaining st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. (16 dc)

Sl st in the sp between the ch 3 and the next dc. Ch 2, 1 dc in the same sp (beginning Cluster made — the ch 2 stands in for the first dc; a Cluster is 2 dc worked together in the same space: [yo, insert hook in sp, yo and pull up a loop, yo and pull through 2 loops] twice, then yo and pull through all 3 loops on the hook). *Ch 1, Cluster in next sp; rep from * 14 more times, ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. (16 Clusters, 16 ch-1 sps)

Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2, 1 dc in the same sp (beginning Cluster made). *Ch 1, [Cluster, ch 1, Cluster] in next ch-1 sp,** ch 1, Cluster in next ch-1 sp; rep from * 6 more times, then * to ** once, ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. (24 Clusters, 24 ch-1 sps)

Sl st in next ch-1 sp, sl st in next Cluster, sl st in next ch-1 sp (the sp between the 2 Clusters of an increase; in this round, every Cluster and every ch-1 sp counts as 1 st). Ch 3 (counts as dc), [1 dc, ch 2, 2 dc] in the same sp (corner made). *1 dc in each of next 2 sts, 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts, 1 sc in each of next 3 sts, 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts, 1 dc in each of next 2 sts,** [2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc] in next ch-1 sp (corner made); rep from * 2 more times, then * to ** once (the last 2 dc go into the ch-1 sp and the Cluster you slip-stitched across). Join with sl st to top of ch 3. (60 sts, 4 ch-2 corner sps)

Sl st in next dc, sl st in next ch-2 corner sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc), [1 dc, ch 2, 2 dc] in the same sp. *1 dc in each of next 15 sts,** [2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc] in next corner ch-2 sp; rep from * 2 more times, then * to ** once (the last 2 dc go into the top of the ch-3 and the dc you slip-stitched across). Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off, weave in ends. (76 sts, 4 ch-2 corner sps)

Assembly: Make 20 motifs in total, following Rounds 1–6 above. Each motif should measure about 12 in square; if your first one is much larger, use a smaller hook (or a larger hook if it is much smaller) before making the rest, or the blanket will be off by the same amount. Arrange them in 4 columns × 5 rows.

Assembly: Using a yarn needle and Colour 1, sew motifs together through the back loops (see Seaming Techniques), forming a 4 × 5 grid. Sew the 5 motifs of each column together into a strip, then sew the 4 strips together side by side.

Border: Join Colour 1 with sl st to any corner ch-2 sp of the assembled blanket. Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 3 hdc in the same sp (corner made). Working around the outer edge, 1 hdc in each dc. At each join between two motifs, 1 hdc in the corner ch-2 sp of the first motif, 1 hdc in the seam (insert the hook through both motifs' edges), and 1 hdc in the corner ch-2 sp of the next motif. Work 3 hdc in the ch-2 sp at each of the 3 remaining blanket corners. Join with sl st to first hdc. (396 sts)

Border: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). Starting in the same st as the join, 1 hdc in each hdc around, working 3 hdc in the centre hdc of each of the 4 corner groups. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off, weave in ends. (404 sts)
